## Meaning

This monitor fired because the signal deviated from its own learned baseline by more than the configured number of deviations. It did NOT cross a fixed number, so 'the value looks normal to me' is not a reason to close this.

Query:

```
avg(last_15m):anomalies(avg:runtime.thread_pool.utilization{__SCOPE__} by {service}, 'agile', 3, direction='above') >= 1
```

## Impact

Nothing is broken yet. A boundary will be crossed if nobody acts within the lead time this monitor provides.

Error budget: this condition is associated with `slo-app-availability`. If the alert is sustained, expect burn-rate alerts on that objective to follow.

## Automation

Workflow `diag-app-health` (diagnostic only) runs automatically on every alert.

Actions: `fetch_monitor`, `query_recent_errors`, `fetch_deploy_history`, `fetch_dependency_map`.

Attached to the alert automatically: error samples, last 3 deploys, dependency health summary.

## Escalation

1. Owning team: `sre` (see `platform/policy/teams.yaml` for the channel and ServiceNow assignment group).
2. Escalates to: `platform-leadership`.
3. Priority contract: P3 — next business day; this never pages.
